frozen_before: any new P29 pair cross-tabulation for 2008-2024 (only yearly marginals were inspected)

filters: at least one valid P29 code 1-35
no valid code repeated across P29 slots

context.p20a_broad: pilot dictionary broad_theme() (social_reproduction, institutional, cultural, territorial, other, unclassified, missing)

null_models.N1: swap tactic codes between occupied slots of different actions in the same calendar month; preserves list size per action and monthly tactic frequencies
null_models.N2: swap within year x territorial block x P20a broad x slot position; preserves occupied-slot mask per action and slot-specific frequencies per context cell
null_models.N2_clean: N2 after dropping codes 2 and 10 and excluding actions with residual 99, invalid codes or six occupied slots; list sizes recomputed
null_models.N2_order: N2 rejecting swaps that change the ascending-numeric-order status of either action
null_models.N1_k2: N1 restricted to actions with exactly two valid tactics (added in v2 before results: list-size drift sensitivity)

diagnostics: fraction of slots changed vs observed
exact uniformity test on enumerable fixture

eligibility.primary: both tactics >= 50 actions in 2008-2024 main sample AND E_N1(2008-2024) >= 5; applied to every reference
eligibility.per_comparison: E >= 5 and null sd > 0 on both sides, using the reference being evaluated
eligibility.pilot_frozen_sensitivity: both tactics >= 50 actions in 2008-2018 AND E_N1(2008-2018) >= 5

annual.year_vs_rest: theta_rest = log2((sum O_others + 0.5)/(sum E_others + 0.5)); never averaged log ratios

split_half.formula: Spearman-Brown; ceiling = sqrt(rel_year*rel_rest); disattenuated r = r/ceiling

permutation.scheme: permute year labels of months within each calendar month (12 strata x 17 years)
permutation.per_year_flag: observed r below permutation distribution, Holm-adjusted across 17 years

models.MA: log mu = c_t + gamma_h (constant pair shares; no null)

loglinear.decomposition: frequency share = 1 - [D(M1)-Dperm(M1)]/[D(MA)-Dperm(MA)], with permutation means as noise floors
